item.title: Increased HTTP 5xx Errors in Bangkok, Thailand region
item.description: Cloudflare is investigating an increased level of HTTP 5xx errors in Bangkok, Thailand region (BKK). We are working to analyse and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.

item.title: itsourcecode Event Management System manage venue.php sql injection
item.description: A flaw has been found in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /admin/manage venue.php. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

The manipulation results in denial of service. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is identified as 1eabe18bf0cb5a248e0429f4daac91dee51c8a43. It is best practice to apply a patch to…

item.title: ELADMIN through 2.7 Data Scope Bypass via /api/users/download Export
item.description: ELADMIN through 2.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the user export endpoint that allows department-scoped users to export user records from other departments. Authenticated attackers holding user:list permission can request GET /api/users/download to obtain an XLSX containing usernames, roles, emails, and phone numbers across all departments.

item.title: Apprise before 1.12.0 Missing TLS Certificate Validation in mailtos:// SMTP
item.description: Apprise before 1.12.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NotifyEmail.send that ignores verify certificate for SMTPS and STARTTLS connections. Network-positioned attackers can present self-signed or mismatched certificates to intercept SMTP AUTH credentials and notification contents, or modify and suppress notifications.

Attackers can present a crafted USB device with a…

item.title: TinyUSB 0.21.0 Out-of-Bounds Write via mtp container get string()
item.description: TinyUSB through 0.21.0, fixed in commit e85c2b8, contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the MTP device class helper mtp container get string() in src/class/mtp/mtp.h that allows a malicious USB host to corrupt adjacent memory by supplying a crafted MTP string with an unbounded character count. Attackers can exploit the unchecked memcpy operation copying up to 510 bytes into a fixed-size destination buffer…

item.title: Snap7 through 1.4.3 Heap-Based Buffer Overflow via TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL
item.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice SZL responses. A rogue or impersonated PLC can keep flagging more data with attacker-controlled DLen slices, overflowing the 65536-byte opData buffer via Cli ReadSZL() and Cli ReadSZLList(), crashing the client and corrupting heap memory.

item.title: Snap7 through 1.4.3 Out-of-Bounds Write via TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars
item.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

item.title: OpenPLC v3 Heap-Based Buffer Overflow in Modbus Master getData()
item.description: OpenPLC v3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in the getData() function in webserver/core/modbus master.cpp. getData() reads characters between two delimiters into a caller-supplied buffer with no size parameter and no bounds check. In parseConfig() the function is invoked with the 100-byte heap-allocated MB device.dev name field. An authenticated attacker with access to the OpenPLC web interface can send a…

item.title: Cesanta Mongoose Out-of-Bounds Read in MG TLS BUILTIN ClientHello Session ID Parsing
item.description: Cesanta Mongoose before 7.22 contains an out-of-bounds read in the built-in TLS server function mg tls server recv hello(), which uses an attacker-controlled session id len byte from a TLS ClientHello as a buffer index without validating it against the length of received data. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send a single crafted ClientHello with an oversized session id length to read past the receive…

item.title: snap7 through 1.4.3 Out-of-Bounds Write via TSnap7MicroClient::opReadArea
item.description: snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadArea() that allows malicious S7 peers to overflow client buffers via an unchecked DataLength field. Rogue or impersonated PLCs can return crafted ReadVar responses causing memcpy of up to 65535 bytes into caller buffers, crashing SCADA, HMI, or gateway processes and corrupting memory.

item.title: Apache Airflow Reflected Cross-site Scripting vulnerability in 404 Endpoint
item.description: It was noticed an XSS in certain 404 pages that could be exploited to perform an XSS attack. Chrome will detect this as a reflected XSS attempt and prevent the page from loading. However Firefox and other browsers don't, and are vulnerable to this attack. Mitigation: The fix for this is to upgrade to Apache Airflow 1.9.0 or above.
